title: How JSON Web Tokens Actually Work

beats.hook: Do you know what's inside a JWT?
beats.voice: Most developers use JSON web tokens every day without knowing how they work under the hood.
A token is just three Base-64 parts separated by dots: header, payload, and cryptographic signature.

beats.caption: Stateless Auth|Server verifies signature with secret|No database lookup required
beats.voice: Because the signature guarantees integrity, your backend validates users instantly without database lookups.

beats.hook: Never store secrets in your payload
beats.voice: Remember: anyone can decode the payload, so never store sensitive secrets inside it.
